content.title: Flat Token to Physical Spill | Performance Recovery
content.summary: A performer moves within a stable graphic layout. Her movement sits immediately beside the flat-token-to-physical-prop spill, though the source does not prove one gesture caused it. The sudden fall interrupts the routine; a brief recovery restores performance. The paper-theatre transfer adds an explicit sweep trigger as an original causal enhancement, not a claimed source fact. Preserve boundary crossing and reaction-repair, not the branded desktop.

quick_start.input_format: Establish one performer inside a stable graphic layout first. + Place performer motion immediately beside flat tokens gaining mass and falling, without claiming the source proves a particular trigger gesture; a new transfer may make the trigger explicit. + Pause for reaction and recovery, then resume the same performer routine.
